narrative: 摄影机在宣称自己拥有证据效力。一场坐在窗边的访谈。
一个展示劳作过程的全景。一个假装能证明刚才那句话的切出镜头。
喜剧感和不安感都存在于“人们所说的话”与“摄影机看似见证到的东西”之间的那道缝隙里。它比真实电影的概念更宽泛。
真实电影用变焦镜头去寻找画面，并且承认摄制者本身是一种催化剂；纪录片风格则还可以安排一场稳定的访谈、使用档案影像，或者构建一个虚构的摄制组（访谈式风格、观察式的B roll素材）。
它不是伪纪录片：通常暗示着一次正常的制作过程，而不是一盘丢失的录像带。
how: 让色温保持混杂。访谈用窗光作主光，35mm到50mm焦段，眼睛高度，提问者常常在画外。
观察式的全景用变焦镜头拍摄，如果暗示中的摄制组本身也会“寻找”焦点，那么焦点游移是被允许的。除非真实房间里本来就有发丝光源，否则不要加发丝光。
只有在符合那次“制作”的设定时，才使用不完美的覆盖方式。提示词要写：混杂的色温、未经设计的服装光线、变焦寻找焦点的过程、尊重但不魅力化。
when: 当“漂亮”会成为一种谎言时，或者当一部虚构作品想要利用“访谈”与“观察”之间的反讽时，使用纪录片风格。不要把它当作随意的晃动效果，也不要把它替换成一个“寻回摄像机”的故事。
vs: 纪录片风格是一种修辞（访谈、观察、档案影像）；真实电影是一种方法（现场光、在场感、变焦寻找）。
伪纪录片是一台剧情内的录像设备；现场光只是那个光源本身。
幕后花絮展示的是电影片场的剧组；伪纪录喜剧（Mockumentary）把纪录片式的修辞用在虚构的人物身上。
提醒一下：这些概念不能互相替换。
examples_film: 《杀戮演绎》（The Act of Killing）把重演和访谈当作证据来使用。《蜂蜜之地》（Honeyland）观察式的耐心、混杂的自然光。
《罗杰斯先生的邻里》（Won't You Be My Neighbor?）档案影像加正式访谈。
《摇滚万岁》（This Is Spinal Tap）和《最佳表演》（Best in Show）用虚构的摄制组来运用访谈和观察式手法。这是一种语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是伪纪录片，或者光鲜亮丽的访谈：一台恐怖片式的摄像机，或者一场打了主光的脱口秀。破绽是一个时间戳，或者在“纪录片”题材的人物身上出现了好莱坞式的发丝光。
解决办法：确定一种摄制组风格，混杂色温，让变焦镜头或窗光成为画面里唯一的“美化”手段。

faq.a: 一种风格与修辞：观察式的全景、正式访谈、档案影像、混杂的色温，以及未经设计的光线。虚构作品也可以穿上同一件外衣（伪纪录喜剧），却不必因此变成伪纪录片。
真实电影是纪录片的一种具体方法：在场、现场光、变焦寻找。纪录片风格作为一种整体风格，还包括稳定的访谈和档案影像。一场用窗光打光的正式访谈可以是纪录片风格，却依然不是真实电影。
当画面必须看起来像证据，或者一部虚构作品需要“证词”与“观察”之间的缝隙时使用它。跳过它，如果你要拍寻回录像带式的恐怖片、只依赖真实电影式在场感的场景，或者魅力化的轮廓光。

faq.q: How do I prompt Documentary for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：Documentary look on [Subject], mixed color, unstyled wardrobe light, zoom finding focus, interview or observational coverage。点名摄制组的位置。不要加摄像机式的时间戳，或者发丝光。

narrative: The camera claims evidence. A sit-down by a window.
A wide of work being done. A cutaway that pretends to prove the sentence.
Comedy and unease both live in the gap between what people say and what the camera appears to witness. It is broader than Cinéma Vérité.
Vérité hunts with a zoom and admits the filmmaker as catalyst. Documentary may also plant a stable interview, use archive, or build a fictional crew (Interview style, observational B-roll).
It is not Found Footage: there is usually an implied production, not a lost tape.
how: Leave mixed color. Window key for interviews, 35mm to 50mm, eye level, interviewer often offscreen.
Observational wides on a zoom, focus hunting is allowed if the implied crew would hunt. No hair light unless the real room has one.
Imperfect coverage only when it fits that production. Prompt mixed color, unstyled wardrobe light, zoom finding focus, respect without glamour.
when: Use it when pretty would be a lie, or when a fiction wants interview-versus-observation irony. Do not use it as random shake, and do not swap it for a recovered-camera story.
vs: Documentary is a rhetoric (interview, observation, archive). Cinéma Vérité is a method (available light, presence, zoom-to-find).
Found Footage is a diegetic recorder. Available Light is the source only.
BTS shows a film set's crew. Mockumentary uses documentary rhetoric on invented people.
Quality check: those are not interchangeable.
examples_film: The Act of Killing (reenactment and interview as evidence). Honeyland (observational patience, mixed natural light).
Won't You Be My Neighbor? (archive plus sit-down).
This Is Spinal Tap and Best in Show (fictional crews using interview and observation). Grammar, not frames to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Found Footage or glossy interview: a horror camcorder, or a keyed talk show. The tell is a timestamp, or a Hollywood hair light on a 'documentary' subject.
Fix: pick a crew style, mix the color, and let the zoom or the window be the only flattery.

faq.a: A look and a rhetoric: observational wides, sit-down interviews, archive, mixed color, and unstyled light. Fiction can wear the same clothes (mockumentary) without becoming found footage.

Vérité is one documentary method: presence, available light, zoom-to-find. Documentary as a look also includes stable interviews and archive. A window-keyed sit-down can be documentary and still not be vérité.
When the image must look like evidence, or when a fiction needs the gap between testimony and observation. Skip it for recovered-tape horror, for vérité-only catalysis, or for glamour rims.

faq.q: How do I prompt Documentary for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: Documentary look on [Subject], mixed color, unstyled wardrobe light, zoom finding focus, interview or observational coverage. Name the crew position. Do not add a camcorder timestamp or a hair light.
